Localtify 0.5.1 improves everyday listening, large libraries and interface consistency.

## Listening and library

- Faster library indexing and reduced indexing memory, with shared song indexes and less redundant artwork processing.
- Unified Songs, Liked, Artists, Genres and Playlists navigation and collection layouts.
- Cleaner Discover, Downloads, Analytics and Settings pages.
- Responsive immersive player, lyrics, queue and playback controls.
- Retired smart playlists, prompt-based playlists and Cover Studio. Existing saved playlist tracks, audio similarity, normal artwork and bulk artwork reroll remain available.

## Reliability

- Reduced redundant playback processing, improved audio resource cleanup and Android artwork cache management.
- Preserved local listening history, offline playback, library data and device synchronization.

## Downloads

- Windows x64: signed installer.
- Linux x64: AppImage, Debian and RPM packages.
- Android: APK signed with the existing release key.
- Verify published packages using `SHA256SUMS`.
